thread:
Alex K: Morning — quick sync for Friday release train (final cut). Can people owning services confirm readiness and smoke owner? Proposed order: 21:00 UTC auth, 21:10 UTC router, 21:20 UTC runtime. Rolling canaries at 1% -> 10% -> 100%. Rollback criteria: error rate >1% for 5m or any user-facing 5xx spike; rollback to previous tag and open #eng-releases/rollback. @Jamie L you on auth?

Jamie L: On it. Auth has migration lock in place. Smoke owner: Jamie L. I'll run the smoke script and validate login/token flows. Prep ETA: done by 20:30 UTC. Will paste smoke output here.

Sara P: Router is green on staging. Need to validate KV cache toggle with the canary. Smoke owner: Sara P. I'll coordinate with Matt for the runtime kernel flag cross-check.

Matt R: Runtime patch includes a quantization flag flip — quick QA done. I'll be on-call for the window and can trigger rollback if we see memory regressions. If we see repeated OOMs revert quantization.

Deploybot: Scheduled windows registered by release coordinator: auth @ 21:00 UTC, router @ 21:10 UTC, runtime @ 21:20 UTC. Canary window durations: 5m, 10m, then full rollout. Notifications will post to #eng-releases.

Alex K: Thanks. Two asks: 1) Jamie — paste the exact smoke command and the expected green pattern. 2) Everyone — ack the rollback criteria and who will click rollback. Also confirm who will own post-deploy quickcheck (metrics/dash).

Jamie L: Smoke command:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --service=auth --env=prod --checks=login,token-refresh,rate-limit
```
Expected green: logs show "login ok", token refresh success, auth p95 < 120ms, 5xx rate ~0. No errors in auth logs. I ack rollback criteria and I will trigger rollback for auth if thresholds breached. I'll own post-deploy metrics for auth (Datadog dash).

Sara P: Ack rollback criteria. I'll own router post-deploy traces and top-end latencies. If router error rate or TRACE anomalies appear during router canary, I'll hit rollback and ping Matt for runtime coupling issues.

Matt R: Ack. I'll watch infra: if p50 latency > 300ms for >3m or memory usage crosses 75% for the runtime hosts, I will trigger rollback for runtime and coordinate with infra SRE. I'll stand by in the channel during the window.

Alex K: Good. A couple more small items: - Keep deploys to one service rollback-at-a-time to avoid multi-rollbacks. - If any owner needs to delay, say so before 20:45 UTC. Otherwise we proceed. :thumbsup:

Jamie L: green from my side. I'll post smoke output ~20:35 UTC.

Sara P: green. KV toggle validated on staging at 20:10.

Matt R: green. Watching memory & kernel logs.

Alex K: Thanks all — I'll flip canary routing after first canary passes. See you in #eng-releases during the window.

Deploybot: Reminder scheduled: auth deploy window opens in 35m.

Alex K: Final note — if we need to abort, just post `ABORT deploy <service>` and whoever owns rollback clicks the rollback job in the UI. I'll coordinate the postmortem checklist if we abort.
